name: search_wanted
description: Search the FBI's Wanted persons database — fugitives, Most Wanted, cyber's-most-wanted, terrorists, white-collar suspects, kidnappings/missing persons, and law-enforcement-assistance cases. Returns compact records with reward, warning, and image. Keyless, official FBI data.

query.description: Free-text title search (matches the subject name/case title).

person_classification.description: Filter by person classification, e.g. "Main", "Victim", "Ten Most Wanted".

poster_classification.description: Filter by poster/program category. Common values: "ten" (Ten Most Wanted Fugitives), "cyber", "wcc" (white-collar crime), "terrorist", "kidnap" (kidnappings/missing persons), "ecap" (Endangered Child Alert Program), "seeking-info", "law-enforcement-assistance".

field_office.description: Filter by FBI field office, e.g. "miami", "newyork", "losangeles".

sort_on.description: Field to sort on, e.g. "modified" (default) or "publication".

name: get_wanted
description: Get the full FBI Wanted profile for one person by uid — physical description, aliases, occupations, caution/remarks/details (plain text), reward, field offices, and images. Keyless, official FBI data.

uid.description: The wanted-person uid (from search_wanted / most_wanted results).

name: most_wanted
description: The FBI's Ten Most Wanted Fugitives. Returns the current top-ten list with reward, warning, and image for each. Keyless, official FBI data.
